# CarouselCraft (ColorLib Carousel 15) — Prep Outline & Research

## Overview

- **Source**: ColorLib Carousel 15 (`carousel-15`)
- **New Name**: CarouselCraft (`apps/carouselcraft`)
- **Category**: Carousel / UI Component Showcase

## Section-by-Section Fidelity Notes

1. **Navbar**: Clean top navbar with brand name "CarouselCraft", links, and CTA button.
2. **Hero Section**: Engaging title and subtitle highlighting interactive slider components.
3. **Main Carousel**: Large slide viewport with smooth transition state, caption overlay, prev/next arrow buttons.
4. **Thumbnail Strip**: Row of clickable thumbnail images below the main carousel for quick jump navigation.
5. **Features Grid**: 3-column feature cards detailing responsiveness, touch support, and customization.
6. **Footer**: Standard multi-column footer with copyright and mandatory `https://www.componentdock.com/` attribution link.

## Task Breakdown for Implementer

- [ ] Initialize `apps/carouselcraft` workspace package.
- [ ] Configure `vite.config.ts` with `injectUiSource()`.
- [ ] Implement components (`Navbar`, `Hero`, `Carousel`, `ThumbnailStrip`, `Features`, `Footer`).
- [ ] Write comprehensive unit tests with 100% test coverage.
- [ ] Verify build and local gate.
